## Summary

Describe the focused behavior or documentation change.

## Safety impact

- [ ] Planning remains non-mutating, or this change is explicitly authorized apply work.
- [ ] Ambiguous evidence still fails closed.
- [ ] No overwrite, deletion, private-library data, or machine-specific paths were introduced.

## Validation

- [ ] CI constraints
- [ ] Ruff lint and format
- [ ] mypy
- [ ] offline tests with branch coverage
- [ ] repository privacy and artifact gate
- [ ] wheel and source-distribution smoke tests when packaging is affected

## Evidence

List fabricated regression cases and the exact validation commit. Do not attach real library inventories, plans, caches, or reports.
